message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a system for running three large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models locally on consumer/prosumer hardware, plus two technical appendices (an agent benchmark tool and RDNA HIP expert kernels).

## 1. Project Maya overview

**Purpose:** Run three large MoE models privately on your own GPU(s), with no data leaving the machine.

**Models supported:**
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (zai-org, MIT, 321 B total / 18 B active, up to 1M context)
- **DeepSeek-V4.
